name: arkiv-ideathon-selisih-layak
description: SELISIH (DeFi) and LAYAK (Other): Arkiv data-model designs with SDK-verified sketches, executable invariants and real-data evidence

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:invariants
scripts.build:demo: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && esbuild dist/video/demo/demo.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --outfile=submissions/video/demo/demo.js && esbuild dist/video/demo/selisih.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --outfile=submissions/video/demo/selisih.js
scripts.video:demo: python submissions/video/demo/narrate.py layak && node submissions/video/demo/record.mjs layak
scripts.video:selisih: python submissions/video/demo/narrate.py selisih && node submissions/video/demo/record.mjs selisih
